featured_reviews.name: Parinita
featured_reviews.review_text:
Their work is clumsy, not at all efficient in terms of quality cost or time.
They didn't put on any extension but they still charged INR 1200. Indeed it was my choice to not get the extension. But they could have given some discount. On the other hand there was lady who came in front of me got done the nail work done and in cheaper rates then me because she negotiated before hand. 😀😀
There are two nail artists and they both decided to work on my hands simultaneously. One hand each.
They both had different finishing and they also didn't work on shaping part of the nails. The art also started coming off within 1 hour of the work.
